variants.name: Full-chest belt (gospel / soul / R&B / Mexican ranchera / Latin Caribbean dance-belted)
Fry-bleed voice (vocal fry leaking into modal)
Pressed phonation (high subglottal pressure + supraglottal constriction)
Minimal pressure / under-sung (conversation volume or below)
Sustained full-voice fortissimo (flow phonation at maximal loudness)
Delayed-onset vibrato (straight tone blooming into vibrato)
Melisma-heavy (runs and riffs on single syllables)
Hocket (interlocked note-trading, one melody split across voices)
Call-and-response (leader phrase answered by response phrase)
Patter (rapid-fire syllabic delivery at tongue-twister tempo)
Modern pop / contemporary commercial vocal training
Baroque ornamental (trills, divisions, messa di voce)
Chinese classical vocal (kunqu, jingju, traditional folk)
Mediterranean demotic folk-vocal (Greek, Sardinian, Corsican, Romanian, Balkan)
Mande jeli / griot vocal (Mali, Senegal, Guinea, Gambia)
Andean Quechua / Aymara wayno vocal (Andes highland)
Southeast Asian folk vocal (lam / mor-lam, luk-thung)
Southern African Bantu vocal (Zulu / Xhosa / Tsonga choral chant, isicathamiya to township pop)
Overtone formant-isolation (F2 reinforcement, 2-3 kHz whistle harmonic over low fundamental)
Ventricular co-oscillation subharmonic (false-folds at half true-fold rate, F0 70-100 Hz per Lindestad 2001)
Aryepiglottic pseudoglottis steppe-undertone (raspier high subharmonic with AES engagement)
Tahrir tekye-chain (glottal-appoggiatura M1→M2 jump-chain per Castellengo/During)
False-fold distorted (ventricular noise + supraglottic compression, true-folds protected)
Ingressive-egressive paired-breath alternation (interlocked supraglottic+aryepiglottic both phases)
M1 with M0-pulse borrowing (fry-modal mix, growl-into-modal)
Supraglottal rasp on a clean core (controlled ventricular/AES grain, soft throat-clear; true-fold pitch untouched)
Diplophonic biphonation (two independent simultaneous fundamentals, incommensurate F0 from asymmetric/split fold vibration)
Speech quality (modal, neutral larynx, minimal AES narrowing)
Falsetto quality (thin folds, breathier than M2-modal)
Sob quality (low larynx + thin folds — darkened, muffled weeping)
Oral twang (AES narrowed for high-F2 brightness, velum closed)
Nasal twang (AES narrowed + velar port open)
Opera quality (low larynx + thick folds + AES narrowing + torso anchoring — singer-formant cluster ~2.3-3 kHz per Sundberg)
Belt quality (high larynx + thick folds + AES narrowing + head-neck anchoring)
Cry quality (thin folds + tilted thyroid, larynx higher than sob — small, sweet, plaintive)
Rhythmic spoken flow (no pitch target, rhythmic only)
Melismatic singing (long runs on one syllable)
Sprechstimme (notated pitch touched then released, speech-dominant)
Toasting / deejay chat (pitched rhythmic chant over riddim)
Antiphonal double-choir (spatially opposed groups trading phrases)
Heterophonic ensemble (one melody, individually varied — village-choir blur)
Hocket interlocked single-note distribution across voices
Polyrhythmic vocal layering (independent cycles per voice)
Gang-vocal unison-octave (multiple performers, deliberate non-tuned overlap)
Homophonic block-chord (all voices in one rhythm, chord-stacked)
Round / canon (one melody at staggered entries)
Carnatic gamaka catalog (kampita 1-3 semitone target, nokku above-press, jaaru glide, sphurita double-touch, ravai higher-touch, kandippu implied, andolanam slow-oscillation)

Hindustani meend-gamak catalog (meend continuous-glide >100ms, gamak forceful-wide 200+cent oscillation, khatka cluster-grace, murki rapid-3-note-cluster ~150ms, zamzama chained-murki, krintan hammered-grace, andolan slow 100-cent oscillation)
Persian tahrir mechanics (tekye single glottal-jump M1-M2 unit, bolboli extended chain, zinat pattern, multi-tekye long-interval pattern)
Arab mawwāl + maqam ornament rules (improvised melismatic pre-metric, layali vocable, maqam modulation jins-change mid-phrase)

Quranic tajwid pitch-and-duration rules (tahqiq slow-melismatic, tarteel measured, tadwir medium-tempo, hadr fast, madd vowel-elongation 2-4-6 counts, qalqalah bounce-articulation, ghunnah nasalization)

Bel canto operatic ornaments (appoggiatura leaning-note-on-beat, mordente rapid-neighbor-note, gruppetto turn-figure, trillo rapid-pitch-reiteration 2-12 Hz, portamento laryngeal-glide, messa-di-voce crescendo-decrescendo-sustained, coloratura rapid-melismatic)

Flamenco cante jondo (quejío sung-cry-onset, ayeo introductory-vocable, temple warm-up, melisma cante-jondo-extended, microtonal-flattening 30-60 cents, afilla roughened-voice, quiebro semitone-vibrato, tercio verse-melodic-unit)

Pansori sigimsae (yoseong pitch-oscillation, toeseong descending-off-glide, chuseong ascending-into-slide, jeonseong grace-note-attack, nonghyeon microtonal-bend, seongeum rough-pressed-target-timbre)

Jingju role-type mechanism (laosheng da-sang chest-modal, xiaosheng register-break stylized, qingyi xiao-sang reinforced-falsetto, jing pressed-loud — larynx-elevated singer-formant absent per Sundberg 2012)
Cantonese yueju opera (pinghou flat-throat-modal, zihou reinforced-falsetto, dahou chest-high-pitch-rough)
Sub-Saharan vocal ornament (aka yodel-mechanism-M1-M2 alternation, mande griot melisma extended, yoruba melisma tone-language-coupled, xhosa eefing rhythmic-percussion-vocal)
Sami yoik (luohti circular-form, vocable non-lexical-repetition, glissando-vibrato figure, throaty-rumble onset, high-pitched-cry)
Polynesian (leo kiekie falsetto-break-octave-leap, glottal-stop rhythmic-okina, parallel-thirds himene-tarava)
Andean huayno/yaravi (falsetto-break cabeza-voice high-register, parallel-thirds quechua-aymara, microtonal-flatten andean-mode-third)
Sean-nós ornament catalog (Connemara-style roll/casadh grace-clusters, melismatic free-rhythm line, glottal separation, nasal decoration)
Dhrupad meend + andolan (austere extended-glide + slow oscillation, pakhawaj-paired)
Fado voltinha catalog (voltinha small-turn figures, phrase-end melisma, rubato note-stretching, mordent-glide inflection)
Gospel runs-and-riffs catalog (pentatonic run-cascade, chained riff-turns, trap-door descending run, blue-third melisma, squall accent)
Quarter-comma meantone (pure thirds, unequal key colors)
Pythagorean fifth-stacked (pure fifths, bright wide thirds)
Thai seven-equal (171-cent even steps, blurred thirds)
Ethiopian qenet pentatonic modes (tizita, bati, ambassel, anchihoye)
Sub-semitone descending-glide on third scale degree (30-60 cents flatten)
Georgian non-tempered triadic (pure-fifth anchored, neutral thirds)
Multiband compression aggressive-broadcast (dense forward loudness, no dynamic air)
Sidechain-ducked pumping (vocal keyed to the kick, rhythmic swell-back)
Reverse-reverb pre-swell (reversed tail rising into the word onset)
Megaphone / bullhorn (horn-loaded midrange honk, peaky mechanical cut)
Screwed pitch-down (-4 to -8 semitones, slowed tape-speed drawl)
Tape-delay throw (send opened on the phrase-end word, regenerating repeats)
Spring reverb (boingy metallic drip-tail, dub-console send)
Slapback tape echo (single 80-140ms repeat, no regeneration)
ADT / tape-offset unison double (phasey detimed halo)
Massed bus-glued stack drowned in gated/plate reverb (arena-scale wash)
Surgically time-and-pitch-aligned comp stack (zero-flam edit lock)
Cent-locked microtuned harmony stack (beatless glassy interval tuning)
Massed tape-loop choir wall (sustained vowel loops, fader-played)
Ad-lib / echo-word response lane (punctuating second comp track)
